title: Railway footer
description: A quiet dark footer: one or two announcement cards with a violet title ending on the left, six link groups in a 3×2 grid on the right and small compliance marks below, then a hairline and a bottom row with the brand mark, a green mono status line and the copyright. Phones get two link columns and a centred bottom row.
notes: the featured cards and badges show from lg up, as on the original
name: railway-footer

props.name: featuredLabel
props.description: small label above the featured cards

props.name: featured
props.description: one or two announcement cards (desktop only)

props.name: groups
props.description: six link groups, laid out three across on desktops and two on phones

props.name: badges
props.description: small compliance marks under the cards (desktop only): text or images

props.name: mark
props.description: the brand mark in the bottom row

props.name: status
